verification: Read-only pinned local source and rules review; no played-game, iOS runtime or win-rate verification. Source code is not copied into this evidence file.
publicFetch: A direct GitHub pinned-file fetch returned 404; source assertions rely on the locally verified commit, not a claim of public URL availability.

reviewedFacts.finding: Science: Apollo Program plus 3 SS Boosters, 1 Cockpit, 1 Engine, 1 Stasis Chamber added in the capital. Culture: 5 completed policy branches and Utopia. Diplomatic: global UN construction and a winning vote. Time exists; no default religious victory.
Domination counts current original-major-capital ownership; includes the player own original capital. Victory screen handles exceptional missing-capital or never-settled cases.

Piety and Rationalism are mutually exclusive; Freedom, Autocracy and Order are mutually exclusive. Tradition/Piety/Patronage/Commerce/Freedom is a compatible example of five branches, not a claimed optimal order.
Policy cost includes adopted policy count, non-puppet cities, map-size modifier, policy effects, human difficulty and game speed.

University science +33%, two Scientist slots; National College science +50%; Hermitage culture +50%; Research Lab science +50%. National College requires Libraries and Hermitage requires Opera Houses in non-puppet cities.

Spaceship part technology/resource/quantity and no-purchase rules verified. Apollo and Utopia Cannot be hurried; normal Gold purchase of national/world wonders is unavailable without a specific permission.

Unmodified connection Gold = capital population * 0.15 + other population * 1.1 - 1. Ordinary road base maintenance 1 Gold per maintained tile. Example 6/4 population ->4.3; five added maintained tiles ->-0.7 before other effects.
UN owner vote weight 2, ordinary vote weight 1; threshold depends on available voting civs and UN state; tied highest vote fails. AI majors consider opinions and may abstain; city-states choose ally.

Catapult needs setup and has no defensive terrain bonus; normal ranged bombardment does not capture. Great Artist can make Landmark or Golden Age; Great Scientist can create Academy or accelerate research.
Prophet founding/enhancement require unused other actions; Missionary foreign-territory attrition, Inquisitor active-spread blocking/removal, Tithe and Pagodas conditions checked.
Guide names normalized to pinned Chinese labels; all Chinese entity-link labels equal current database titles.
